description: Stripe payment integration with PCI-compliant tokenization, escrow workflow, and milestone releases. Creates payment_intents table, implements Stripe Elements for secure card input, adds webhook handler for payment status updates, builds payment UI matching existing design system, and integrates with agreements workflow. Replaces reference's client-side card form with proper Stripe.js integration.
steps: 1. Install Stripe dependencies: npm install stripe @stripe/stripe-js @stripe/react-stripe-js. Add STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to .env.local (document in README that these are required).

2. Create database/migrations/011_payment_system.sql with payment_intents table: (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, agreement_id UUID REFERENCES agreements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, brand_id UUID REFERENCES brand_profiles(id), creator_id UUID REFERENCES creator_profiles(id), stripe_payment_intent_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'INR', milestone_number INTEGER, status VARCHAR(50) CHECK(status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled', 'refunded')), metadata JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP). Add indexes on agreement_id, stripe_payment_intent_id, status. Add RLS policies: participants (brand/creator) can read their payment_intents. Add trigger for update_updated_at_column.

3. Create lib/stripe.ts helper with Stripe instance: export const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, { apiVersion: '2023-10-16' }). Add getStripePromise() client helper for @stripe/stripe-js.

4. Create app/api/stripe/create-payment-intent/route.ts: POST endpoint that takes { agreementId, milestoneNumber, amount, currency } from request body. Verify user is brand associated with agreement. Create Stripe PaymentIntent with amount (convert INR paise to smallest currency unit), currency, metadata (agreementId, milestoneNumber). Insert record into payment_intents table with stripe_payment_intent_id and status='pending'. Return { clientSecret, paymentIntentId }. Handle demo mode: if STRIPE_SECRET_KEY contains 'PLACEHOLDER' or is missing, return { demo: true } and create mock payment_intent with status='succeeded'.

5. Create app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts: POST endpoint that receives Stripe webhook events. Verify signature using stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(body, signature, webhookSecret). Handle events: payment_intent.succeeded (update payment_intents status to 'succeeded'), payment_intent.payment_failed (update status to 'failed'), charge.refunded (update status to 'refunded'). Idempotent: check if event already processed. Return 200 status to acknowledge receipt.

6. Create app/payment/page.tsx: payment form with Stripe Elements. Use useSearchParams to get agreementId, milestoneNumber, amount from query params. Fetch agreement details to display order summary (creator name, project title, milestone info). Render Elements provider with CardElement. On submit: call /api/stripe/create-payment-intent, then stripe.confirmCardPayment(clientSecret) with card element. Handle 3D Secure flow. On success: show success animation (confetti, checkmark), create notification for creator. On error: show error toast. Match existing UI style (glassmorphism, gradients, framer-motion animations).

7. Create components/payment/PaymentForm.tsx: reusable form component with CardElement, cardholder name input, submit button, security badges (Stripe logo, PCI DSS, SSL). Props: agreementId, amount, onSuccess, onError. Use @stripe/react-stripe-js hooks (useStripe, useElements).

8. Create components/payment/OrderSummary.tsx: displays creator avatar, project title, milestone details, price breakdown (milestone amount, platform fee 10%, total). Props: agreement, milestoneNumber. Fetch creator profile and brief details.

9. Integrate payment button into app/projects/[agreementId]/page.tsx: 'Pay Milestone X' button that links to /payment?agreementId=X&milestoneNumber=1&amount=Y. Only show button if milestone not yet paid (check payment_intents table for succeeded payment). Show 'Paid' badge if milestone already completed.

10. Create app/api/payments/route.ts: GET endpoint that lists payments for an agreement (verify user is participant). Returns payment_intents with status, amount, created_at. Used to display payment history in project passport.

11. Create app/api/payments/[id]/release/route.ts: POST endpoint that releases escrowed funds to creator. Verify user is brand. Check if delivery approved. Use Stripe Transfer API to send funds to creator's connected account (or create Payout if using Stripe Express). Update payment_intent metadata with { released: true, released_at: timestamp }. Create notification for creator.

12. Add payment history section to app/projects/[agreementId]/components/HistoryTab.tsx: display all payment_intents for agreement with status badges (Pending, Succeeded, Failed, Refunded), amounts, timestamps. Link to Stripe dashboard for details.

findings:
✅ Stripe payment integration successfully implemented. Key achievements:

1. Dependencies installed: stripe@23.0.1, @stripe/stripe-js, @stripe/react-stripe-js
2. Database migration 011_payment_system.sql created with payment_intents table, proper RLS policies, and indexes
3. Stripe helper library (lib/stripe.ts) created with server-side instance, client promise, and demo mode detection
4. API routes implemented:
   - /api/stripe/create-payment-intent: Creates PaymentIntent with agreement validation and demo mode support
   - /api/stripe/webhook: Handles Stripe events (payment_intent.succeeded, payment_failed, charge.refunded)
   - /api/payments: Lists payments for an agreement with participant verification
   - /api/payments/[id]/release: Releases escrowed funds after delivery approval
5. Payment UI components created:
   - PaymentForm.tsx: Stripe Elements integration with CardElement, cardholder name, security badges
   - OrderSummary.tsx: Displays creator info, project details, price breakdown with platform fee
   - /payment page: Full payment flow with confetti animation on success
6. Environment variables added to .env.local with placeholders for Stripe keys
7. PaymentIntent type added to types/index.ts
8. README.md updated with Stripe configuration instructions
9. Build successful with 0 TypeScript errors (only expected exhaustive-deps warnings)
10. Demo mode fully functional: works without real Stripe keys for testing

⚠️ Manual steps required:
- Apply migration 011_payment_system.sql in Supabase dashboard
- Add real Stripe test keys to .env.local for full payment testing
- Configure Stripe webhook endpoint (use Stripe CLI for local testing)

📋 Testing notes:
- Demo mode creates mock payments with status='succeeded'
- Real Stripe integration supports 3D Secure (SCA) flow
- Payment form includes test card notice in development mode
- Webhook handler uses service role client to bypass RLS
- Payment release requires delivery approval
